description:
From the first Russian explorers who crossed the Bering Strait to the gold-seekers of the Klondike, Alaska has always drawn those chasing something beyond reach. 
Travel through the Last Frontier — from Sitka’s Russian past to the icy fjords of Kenai, the tundra of Nome, and the bears of Katmai — and discover a world that remains truly unconquered.
